banner.acting: You are acting as {account}. Every change is logged.
banner.takeover: {name} took over this chat. The agent is paused and follow-ups are cancelled.
banner.test: Test mode. Messages and payments are not real and do not count in reports.
app.title: Sales at Scale
access.no_account.title: You don't have access to a seller account yet
access.no_account.body: Seller accounts are created by the Sales at Scale team, and you join one from an invite link. You are signed in as {email}. If your invite went to another address, sign out and sign in with that one.
access.picker.title: Choose an account
placeholder.title: {section} is not built yet
placeholder.body: This screen arrives in {phase} of the implementation plan.
overview.setting_up.title: Your workspace is being set up
overview.setting_up.body: The agent will not contact anyone until every go-live check passes. The setup wizard arrives in a later phase.
invite.title: Join {account} on Sales at Scale
invite.body: {inviter} invited you as {role}. This invite is for {email}.
invite.body_no_inviter: You are invited as {role}. This invite is for {email}.
invite.not_found: This invite link is not valid. Check that you copied the whole link, or ask for a new invite.
invite.expired: This invite has expired. Ask the person who invited you for a new one.
invite.accepted: This invite was already used. If it wasn't you, ask for a new invite.
invite.revoked: This invite was cancelled. Ask for a new invite.
invite.email_mismatch: This invite is for {invited}, but you are signed in as {current}. Sign out and sign in with {invited}, or ask for an invite to your address. The address must be verified.
admin.accounts.title: Accounts
admin.accounts.empty: No seller accounts yet. Create the first one to start setting up a seller.
admin.accounts.setup_pending: The go-live checklist arrives with the setup wizard (P8).
admin.create.title: Create a seller account
admin.create.intro: The account starts in Setting up. Nothing contacts buyers until it passes Go live. The owner gets an invite as seller admin.
admin.create.conversation_limit_hint: Leave empty for the plan default.
admin.create.errors: Fix the highlighted fields and try again.
admin.ops.title: Operations and usage
access.paused.seller: This account is paused. The agent sends no messages. Contact Sales at Scale to resume it.
access.paused.admin: This account is paused. The agent sends no messages until you resume it.
invite_link.body: Send this link to {who}. It works once and expires on {date}.
invite_link.label: Invite link
invite_link.footnote: Invites will be emailed automatically once email is set up.
leads.title: Leads
leads.empty.title: No leads yet
leads.empty.body: Leads from your website form arrive here automatically. You can also add one by hand or import a list.
leads.filtered.title: No leads match these filters
leads.error.title: We couldn't load your leads
leads.error.body: This is on our side and nothing was lost. Try again in a moment.
lead.form.title: Add lead
lead.form.name: Full name
lead.form.source_hint: For example: Trade show, Referral, Website form
lead.form.consent_check: This person asked to be contacted on WhatsApp
lead.form.consent_hint: Required. The agent never contacts a lead without a consent record.
lead.form.after_agent: The agent contacts them once your account is live
lead.form.errors: Fix the highlighted fields and try again.
lead.form.consent_required: Tick the consent box and say how this person agreed. Without it the lead can't be saved.
lead.form.phone_conflict: Another lead already has this phone number.
lead.card.wait_live: The agent sends the opening message once your account is live, inside your contact hours.
lead.card.human_owner: {name} will contact this lead. The agent won't message them.
lead.card.opted_out: This lead opted out. Nobody will contact them.
lead.card.learn_pending: The fields the agent asks about come from your playbook, which arrives with the agent setup.
lead.card.consent_none: No consent record. This lead can't be contacted.
lead.card.opt_out_hint: Use this when the person asks not to be contacted. It can't be undone here.
lead.card.existing: A lead with this phone number already existed, so it was updated.
import.title: Import leads from CSV
import.intro: Each row needs a name, a phone number, consent set to yes and how the person agreed. Rows with the same phone or source ID update the existing lead.
import.missing_columns: The file is missing these columns: {columns}. Nothing was imported.
import.too_many: The file has more than 2,000 rows. Split it and import each part.
import.bad_file: Choose a CSV file of up to 1 MB.
settings.title: Settings
settings.more: WhatsApp, payments, notifications and contact hours arrive with the WhatsApp channel (P6).
settings.intake.title: Lead intake from your website
settings.intake.body: Your website or CRM sends new leads to this address, with a key and the lead's consent. Send from your server, never from the browser, so the key stays secret.
settings.intake.name: Key name
settings.intake.new_key: Copy this key now. For security it is shown only once.
settings.intake.docs: Field reference: docs/lead-intake.md in the repository.
